meta.source: screenshot: three mobile screens (Lucky Games lobby, Win Gallery, Lucky Tokkens wallets)

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the app frame and full-bleed page background on web.

tokens.name: bg-sheet
tokens.usage: Body of a bottom sheet or navy screen (Win Gallery, Wallets); header zone sits directly on it.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Grouped section panels on bg-sheet: Rewards, Wallets, Bonus Level, the Lucky Tokkens balance header.

tokens.name: bg-well
tokens.usage: List rows inset into a panel (wallet rows, Room card footer).

tokens.name: bg-tile
tokens.usage: Reward tiles and the progress track: the darkest inset, one step below bg-well.

tokens.name: bg-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons (Add new) and quiet controls on bg-panel.

tokens.name: bg-control-hover
tokens.usage: Circular icon buttons (back arrow) and the hover/pressed state of bg-control.

tokens.name: lobby
tokens.usage: Body of the blue games-lobby screen (Lucky Games home), behind Rooms.

tokens.name: lobby-raised
tokens.usage: Segmented tab cells and raised surfaces on lobby.

tokens.name: lobby-active
tokens.usage: The selected segmented tab cell on lobby.

tokens.name: hero-sky
tokens.usage: Light periwinkle stage behind the featured-game illustration in the hero carousel.

tokens.name: hero-indigo
tokens.usage: The peeking side cards of the hero carousel.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Electric-blue 1px outline of the app frame on the lobby. Decorative, not a control border.

tokens.name: frame-muted
tokens.usage: 1px outline of navy sheets (Win Gallery, Wallets). Decorative.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and the top edge of panels.

tokens.name: control-ring
tokens.usage: Unselected radio ring on wallet rows; 3.2:1 on bg-panel, 3.8:1 on bg-well.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, amounts and primary labels on every surface above (15:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Sub-titles under a heading ("status: basic") on bg-sheet and bg-panel.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Label of secondary buttons on bg-control (Add new), tab labels on lobby-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Timers, meta labels (seats, Entry, Max.players) on any surface; 7:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Helper line under a heading ("Until your next reward") on bg-panel. Source value: 3.3:1 on bg-panel, below 4.5:1 — use only at 20px+ and never for information that is not repeated elsewhere.

tokens.name: lucky
tokens.usage: The brand green. Brand word in two-tone headings ("Lucky" Tokkens, "User's" Rooms), bonus amounts, level numbers; as text on every navy surface (10:1+).

tokens.name: lucky-bar
tokens.usage: Progress fill, the selected reward tile's 2px border, check badges.

tokens.name: lucky-tint
tokens.usage: Green wash on the selected wallet row, behind ink and lucky text.

tokens.name: on-lucky
tokens.usage: Text or glyphs on a lucky / lucky-bar fill (the check mark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Premium and VIP: the Pro pill, "pro" labels on tiles, coin and USD fills; as text on navy surfaces (9:1+).

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: Eyebrow over the active tab ("crypto") and its indicator bar.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Ring stroke around the seat counter on Room cards.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill (the Pro pill label).

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: The one hot call to action (FREE PLAY!) and count badges. White label on it is 4.1:1: bold 19px+ only.

tokens.name: hot-light
tokens.usage: Top of the hot gradient and the badge highlight.

tokens.name: on-hot
tokens.usage: Label on a hot fill, bold 19px+ only.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Bonus lines on non-USD wallets ("dp.bonus 20 fs"); as text on bg-well and bg-panel (7:1+).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Partial-progress stripe under a locked reward tile.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface (10:1+).

tokens.name: coin-usd
tokens.usage: USD wallet disc (the + icon).

tokens.name: coin-eur
tokens.usage: EUR wallet disc.

tokens.name: coin-btc
tokens.usage: BTC wallet disc.

tokens.name: coin-usdt
tokens.usage: Tether / USDT wallet disc.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen hero title; two-tone with the brand word in lucky.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Wallet balances and the VP total.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tab labels and the hot CTA (weight 800).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Timers, tile names, seats / Entry labels.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Numbers in badges and rings; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, eyebrow gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between reward tiles and between list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding at the edges, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding and card content padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and header padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above section headlines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Hot CTA, Pro pill, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Reward tiles, segmented tab cells, wallet rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Section panels and Room cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App frame and bottom-sheet corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, badges, currency discs, radios.

tokens.name: glow-lucky
tokens.usage: Selected reward tile.

tokens.name: glow-hot
tokens.usage: Hot CTA and count badges.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: Coin illustration and Pro pill.
